verses.text: “Can you draw out Leviathan with a fish hook, or press down his tongue with a cord?
lines: “Can you draw out Leviathan with a fish hook,
or press down his tongue with a cord?

verses.text: Can you put a rope into his nose, or pierce his jaw through with a hook?
lines: Can you put a rope into his nose,
or pierce his jaw through with a hook?

verses.text: Will he make many petitions to you, or will he speak soft words to you?
lines: Will he make many petitions to you,
or will he speak soft words to you?

verses.text: Will he make a covenant with you, that you should take him for a servant forever?
lines: Will he make a covenant with you,
that you should take him for a servant forever?

verses.text: Will you play with him as with a bird? Or will you bind him for your girls?
lines: Will you play with him as with a bird?
Or will you bind him for your girls?

verses.text: Will traders barter for him? Will they part him among the merchants?
lines: Will traders barter for him?
Will they part him among the merchants?

verses.text: Can you fill his skin with barbed irons, or his head with fish spears?
lines: Can you fill his skin with barbed irons,
or his head with fish spears?

verses.text: Lay your hand on him. Remember the battle, and do so no more.
lines: Lay your hand on him.
Remember the battle, and do so no more.

verses.text: Behold, the hope of him is in vain. Won’t one be cast down even at the sight of him?
lines: Behold, the hope of him is in vain.
Won’t one be cast down even at the sight of him?

verses.text: None is so fierce that he dare stir him up. Who then is he who can stand before me?
lines: None is so fierce that he dare stir him up.
Who then is he who can stand before me?

verses.text: Who has first given to me, that I should repay him? Everything under the heavens is mine.
lines: Who has first given to me, that I should repay him?
Everything under the heavens is mine.

verses.text: “I will not keep silence concerning his limbs, nor his mighty strength, nor his goodly frame.
lines: “I will not keep silence concerning his limbs,
nor his mighty strength, nor his goodly frame.

verses.text: Who can strip off his outer garment? Who will come within his jaws?
lines: Who can strip off his outer garment?
Who will come within his jaws?

verses.text: Who can open the doors of his face? Around his teeth is terror.
lines: Who can open the doors of his face?
Around his teeth is terror.

verses.text: Strong scales are his pride, shut up together with a close seal.
lines: Strong scales are his pride,
shut up together with a close seal.

verses.text: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.
lines: One is so near to another,
that no air can come between them.

verses.text: They are joined to one another. They stick together, so that they can’t be pulled apart.
lines: They are joined to one another.
They stick together, so that they can’t be pulled apart.

verses.text: His sneezing flashes out light. His eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.
lines: His sneezing flashes out light.
His eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.

verses.text: Out of his mouth go burning torches. Sparks of fire leap out.
lines: Out of his mouth go burning torches.
Sparks of fire leap out.

verses.text: Out of his nostrils a smoke goes, as of a boiling pot over a fire of reeds.
lines: Out of his nostrils a smoke goes,
as of a boiling pot over a fire of reeds.

verses.text: His breath kindles coals. A flame goes out of his mouth.
lines: His breath kindles coals.
A flame goes out of his mouth.

verses.text: There is strength in his neck. Terror dances before him.
lines: There is strength in his neck.
Terror dances before him.

verses.text: The flakes of his flesh are joined together. They are firm on him. They can’t be moved.
lines: The flakes of his flesh are joined together.
They are firm on him.
They can’t be moved.

verses.text: His heart is as firm as a stone, yes, firm as the lower millstone.
lines: His heart is as firm as a stone,
yes, firm as the lower millstone.

verses.text: When he raises himself up, the mighty are afraid. They retreat before his thrashing.
lines: When he raises himself up, the mighty are afraid.
They retreat before his thrashing.

verses.text: If one attacks him with the sword, it can’t prevail; nor the spear, the dart, nor the pointed shaft.
lines: If one attacks him with the sword, it can’t prevail;
nor the spear, the dart, nor the pointed shaft.

verses.text: He counts iron as straw; and bronze as rotten wood.
lines: He counts iron as straw;
and bronze as rotten wood.

verses.text: The arrow can’t make him flee. Sling stones are like chaff to him.
lines: The arrow can’t make him flee.
Sling stones are like chaff to him.

verses.text: Clubs are counted as stubble. He laughs at the rushing of the javelin.
lines: Clubs are counted as stubble.
He laughs at the rushing of the javelin.

verses.text: His undersides are like sharp potsherds, leaving a trail in the mud like a threshing sledge.
lines: His undersides are like sharp potsherds,
leaving a trail in the mud like a threshing sledge.

verses.text: He makes the deep to boil like a pot. He makes the sea like a pot of ointment.
lines: He makes the deep to boil like a pot.
He makes the sea like a pot of ointment.

verses.text: He makes a path shine after him. One would think the deep had white hair.
lines: He makes a path shine after him.
One would think the deep had white hair.

verses.text: On earth there is not his equal, that is made without fear.
lines: On earth there is not his equal,
that is made without fear.

verses.text: He sees everything that is high. He is king over all the sons of pride.”
lines: He sees everything that is high.
He is king over all the sons of pride.”
